stem: A test randomises users and analyses page views. In which case is the design effect DE = 1 + (m - 1) × ρ equal to 1, so that the page views can be treated as independent?

options.text: The test has more than 100,000 page views in each variant
The users were assigned to the variants by a random draw
Each user has one page view, or one user's views are uncorrelated
The correlation of page views within a user is ρ = 1
